main.description: Edit an existing Graze feed generator for the authenticated account. A successful edit enqueues a delayed, out-of-band publish. The AppView proxies to the Graze API with its own platform credentials; the caller's service-auth only establishes the viewer DID.

rkey.description: Record key of the feed generator (app.bsky.feed.generator).

filter.description: The Graze algorithm filter object; opaque to the AppView and passed through to Graze.
